message_pillars.label: Time-Debt Absolution: Product Demo with Efficiency Proof
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: Exploit the highest-confidence registration signal in the account. C2B's CN_ProductDemo + HP_Time + FW_BAB combination drove 74 registrations at $9.13 CPA — the lowest CPA control cell on record. The next sprint must stress-test whether this registration efficiency can be extended into checkout depth by layering stronger commitment hooks and social proof into the same ICP concept column, without abandoning the proven efficiency message.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: C2B: 74 Website registrations at $9.13 CPA (spend $675.81, CVR-per-link-click 15.98%). Same cell on Website trials started: 2 results at $220.85 CPA — confirming a hard funnel drop-off between registration and trial. Variable-level: FW_BAB produced 0 checkout conversions on $110.92 spend; HK_Benefit drove 16 checkout results at $55.28 CPA across 5 ads. Demographic cut: female 45-54 top converter at $6.06 CPA (20 results); male 25-34 at $3.09 CPA (4 results, small n). BOOK0 C2 concept rollup: $7.09 blended CPA, 329 results, 15.06% CVR-link — highest confidence, highest volume in full account.
message_pillars.funnel_application: ST_MOFU registration unlock is proven; the sprint must now add ST_BOFU checkout-depth variants within the same concept column. Row structure: Row A = registration-optimised control (FW_BAB replication); Row B = checkout-bridge variant (FW_PAS or FW_StoryBrand with commitment CTA); Row C = social-proof amplification (add PR_Testimonial to existing demo frame); Row D = urgency escalation (TN_Urgent + TN_Assertive overlay on demo creative).
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Column constant: ICP_BOOK2_C2B_QuizCompleter or ICP_BOOK0_C2_TimePoorLearner avatar. Design system: CN_Design_ProductDemo (screen-capture / app-walkthrough visual language). CTA family: CTA_StartFree (proven) tested against CTA_TryFree in Row D only. All four cells share CN_ProductDemo as concept constant; angle variables (FW_, TN_, HK_, PR_) rotate across rows per matrix methodology. FW_BAB is the established control row; alternative frameworks appear in exactly 2–4 cells each.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Broad targeting, ABO, Advantage+ auto-placements. Facebook Reels is the highest-efficiency conversion placement observed ($20.81–$22.35 CPA for checkout, vs $52+ on Feed); brief vertical video formats for all four C2 column cells to capture Reels allocation preferentially. Do not exclude Feed — it carries the majority of impression volume.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: C2 column is the only high-confidence scale candidate. Increase ABO budget incrementally on winning cells once CPA stabilises below $15 for registrations and below $60 for checkout. Avoid scaling before checkout-depth signal is confirmed — current trial CPA of $220.85 on C2B is a scaling blocker.

message_pillars.label: Aspirational Authority: Identity-Led Checkout Driver
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: C4E is the only cell in the account demonstrating meaningful checkout conversion at any volume. The HK_Identity + TN_Aspirational + CN_Lifestyle combination translated aspiration into deeper funnel action better than the efficiency message, producing 14 checkout initiations at $52.57 CPA. The sprint must isolate whether the identity hook or the authority-proxy proof element is driving this behaviour — and test it across multiple avatars to assess generalisability.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: C4E: 14 onb_initiate_checkout at $52.57 CPA (spend $735.99, CTR 2.54%, CVR-per-link-click 4.44%). Same cell: 2 registrations at $3.74 CPA on tiny spend ($7.47) — highest registration efficiency in the account on small sample. HK_Identity variable: 14 checkout results, $52.57 CPA across 2 ads (same cell cluster). TN_Aspirational: 14 checkout results, $52.57 CPA. PR_SocialProof + PR_AuthorityBookCover co-present in all C4E checkout instances. BOOK2 C4 concept rollup: 2 results at $395.61 CPA — but this is heavily diluted by non-C4E cells; C4E specifically outperforms the rollup substantially. Note: C4E sample is modest (315 link clicks to 14 checkouts); confidence is medium, not high.
message_pillars.funnel_application: ST_TOFU to ST_MOFU awareness bridge into checkout initiation. The aspirational concept appears to compress the funnel by activating identity-level motivation rather than rational feature evaluation. Sprint should test this pillar at AW_ProblemAware and AW_SolutionAware levels in different rows — do not assume AW_MostAware is required for checkout response.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Column constant: C3 exploratory column in the MST matrix should carry this pillar as the primary concept test across a different ICP from C2, enabling diagonal isolation. Design system: CN_Design_Lifestyle (aspirational visual language — curated environments, book covers, identity markers). CTA family: CTA_Implicit and CTA_StartFree tested in separate rows. HK_Identity appears in the main diagonal (C3C or C4D position) to generate cross-avatar signal. PR_AuthorityBookCover and PR_SocialProof must both appear in at least 2 cells but can be separated across rows to isolate their individual contribution.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Broad targeting, ABO, Advantage+ auto-placements. Aspirational visual creative is well-suited to Facebook Reels and Instagram Feed (observed CTR of 2.54% and 5.99% on small C4E samples). Brief both vertical and square format to maximise Advantage+ placement allocation without creative constraints.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Do not scale C4 aspirational column until checkout CPA is confirmed below $40 across at least 20 events. Current $52.57 CPA is above acceptable threshold but close enough to warrant continued testing. ICP_BOOK0_MaleEfficiencyPocket (CPA $9.49–$10.33 in demographic overflow) is the most promising unexplored avatar for this concept — brief a purpose-built identity-authority creative for male 35–64 specifically as Row B or C in this column.

message_pillars.label: Retention Mechanism: Behaviour-Shift Problem Hook
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: C2E's CN_BehaviorShift concept — 'read less, keep more' — showed the highest registration CVR-per-link-click in the dataset (16.67%) and generated the account's lowest checkout CPA on tiny spend ($15.55, 1 result). The concept is behaviourally distinct from the efficiency-time pillar and may appeal to a psychographic segment motivated by the frustration of forgetting rather than time scarcity. However, C2E burned $313 on trials with zero conversions in V1, making this a medium-confidence, high-upside exploration that must be structured carefully.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: C2E registration: 2 results at $7.29 CPA (spend $14.58, CVR-per-link-click 16.67% — highest in account). C2E checkout: 1 result at $15.55 CPA (spend $15.55, CVR-per-link-click 10%). C2E trials: 0 results on $313.39 spend (V1 failure). Variable-level: HK_Problem produced 1 checkout result at $15.55 CPA on 1 ad; CN_BehaviorShift produced 1 checkout at $15.55 CPA on 1 ad — both single-ad reads, low confidence. FW_PAS: 1 checkout at $15.55 CPA. Demographic cut (C2E): female 45-54 at $1.49 CPA (1 result, 63 impressions) and female 55-64 at $2.05 CPA (1 result, 54 impressions) — directionally interesting but tiny sample. IAP read: 'Strong curiosity/retention hook. Performance is mixed.'
message_pillars.funnel_application: ST_TOFU to ST_MOFU. The problem-first hook (HK_Problem) opens with the frustration of forgetting — distinct from the time-saving hook — and is better suited to AW_ProblemAware segments who have not yet identified Bookster as the solution. Place HK_Problem variants in early-funnel rows (Row A, Row B); test HK_Benefit bridge as Row C or D within the same concept column.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: This concept should occupy Column 2 (C2) of the MST matrix as a sub-angle row variation within the TimePoorLearner column, OR occupy a dedicated C3 column if a distinct BehaviorShift avatar is hypothesised. FW_PAS is the isolated framework for at least 2 cells (Row A and Row C) to meet the 2–4 appearance rule. TN_Assertive must not dominate — pair with TN_Relatable in at least one cell to test whether the assertive tone is a helping or limiting variable. Given V1 trial failure, optimise against registration first; do not set trial as primary KPI until registration efficiency is re-confirmed.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Broad targeting, ABO, Advantage+ auto-placements. C2E showed 2.10% CTR on 6,142 impressions with zero trials — the hook attracts clicks but does not convert at trial depth. Prioritise thumbstop and CTR as leading signals in early sprint days before drawing funnel conclusions. Reels format recommended given C2E's mixed-context visual demo approach.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Low-confidence pillar. Do not allocate primary budget here. Ring-fence a test budget (recommend 10–15% of sprint ABO) and judge purely on registration CPA after 50+ events. If registration CPA holds below $12 and checkout CVR-per-link-click exceeds 5%, graduate to a dedicated column in the following sprint.

message_pillars.label: Value-Stack Price Comparison: Commercial Clarity for Cost-Hesitant Converters
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: C2F's CN_ValueStack + CN_Comparison concept is the only creative in the account that explicitly addresses HP_Money. It produced both a trial start and a checkout initiation on minimal spend ($38 and $22 respectively), suggesting the commercial clarity message reaches a segment that the efficiency and aspiration concepts do not. This is a low-volume but commercially promising angle that requires structured scale testing in the next sprint. Confidence is low — this is marked as exploratory.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: C2F checkout: 1 result at $21.95 CPA (spend $21.95, CTR 2.59%, CVR-per-link-click 10%). C2F trial: 1 result at $38.01 CPA (spend $38.01, CTR 1.83%, CVR-per-link-click 4.17%). C2F registrations: 0 results on $5.46 spend (insufficient spend). Variable-level: CN_ValueStack, CN_Comparison, FW_FAB, HP_Money — all 1 unique ad, 1 checkout result at $21.95 CPA (single-ad read, low confidence per golden rule). IAP read: 'Commercially clear and produced both a trial and a checkout on small spend. Needs more budget before scaling.' BOOK0 concept rollup has no direct C2F equivalent — this is a new Book2 extension with no legacy baseline.
message_pillars.funnel_application: ST_MOFU to ST_BOFU. Value-stack and comparison messaging is most effective at the solution-aware and most-aware stages (AW_SolutionAware, AW_MostAware) where the prospect is evaluating cost-benefit. Place in Row D (deepest funnel row) across concept columns that have already qualified interest via TOFU hooks in Rows A–C. FW_FAB is the primary framework — isolate it against FW_AIDA in a paired row test.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Column 4 of the MST matrix (C4) designated for exploratory ICP expansion — ICP_BOOK0_MaleEfficiencyPocket or ICP_BOOK0_C5_BYOC_PENDING as the avatar hypothesis. Design system: CN_Design_Comparison (side-by-side or price-anchoring visual language, data-forward layout). CTA family: CTA_TryFree (proven at variable level: 2 checkout results at $18.75 blended CPA across 2 ads). FW_FAB must appear in 2 cells minimum; FW_AIDA in 2 cells minimum — do not allow either to dominate the column. HP_Money must appear in all 4 cells of this column as a constant (it is the column's defining pain point) while proof and tone variables rotate across rows.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Broad targeting, ABO, Advantage+ auto-placements. Value-stack creative is text-heavy by nature; Facebook Feed outperforms Reels for text-dense formats based on placement signal (Feed: 14 checkout results combined across observed placements). Brief a Feed-primary design with a Reels-adapted vertical cut that leads with the most arresting data point (e.g. price-per-book comparison).
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Exploratory column — lowest budget allocation in the sprint. Treat as a hypothesis test only. Success threshold: 5+ checkout initiations at sub-$35 CPA to qualify for dedicated column in Sprint 2. avatar_basis for ICP_BOOK0_MaleEfficiencyPocket in this column: exploratory; no historical creative has been purpose-built for this segment, only algorithmic overflow data exists.

active_hypotheses.label: Replacing FW_BAB with FW_PAS in the C2 TimePoorLearner concept column will increase onb_initiate_checkout rate by reducing the aspirational gap between registration and purchase, because FW_BAB's before/after structure has demonstrated strong registration pull (74 results, $9.13 CPA) but zero checkout conversions ($110.92 spend, 0 checkout results), while FW_PAS's problem-agitation-solution structure may sustain commercial urgency deeper into the funnel.
active_hypotheses.source: C2B (FW_BAB, CN_ProductDemo, HK_Benefit, TN_Rational)
active_hypotheses.risk: FW_PAS may reduce registration volume if the agitation phase creates friction for top-of-funnel users not yet ready to commit. Monitor registration CPA as a guard-rail metric — if it rises above $15 in the FW_PAS row, the framework is hurting TOFU entry.
active_hypotheses.test_variant: Same C2 column constants (ICP_BOOK2_C2B_QuizCompleter, CN_Design_ProductDemo, CTA_StartFree); swap framework to FW_PAS; retain HK_Benefit hook and TN_Rational tone to isolate framework variable only.
active_hypotheses.isolated_variable: FW_PAS vs FW_BAB (framework variable). Distribution: FW_BAB appears in Row A (control replication) across all 4 columns = 4 cells; FW_PAS appears in Row B across all 4 columns = 4 cells. This gives each framework exactly 4 appearances in varied ICP/concept contexts, satisfying the 2–4 rule and enabling cross-avatar framework signal on the counter-diagonal.

active_hypotheses.success_criteria: PR_Testimonial cell achieves onb_initiate_checkout CPA ≤ $40 (vs $52.57 control) with statistical directionality after 15+ checkout events. CTR must not drop below 2.0% — a decline would indicate the testimonial format is failing thumbstop.

active_hypotheses.isolated_variable: HK_Identity vs HK_Benefit (hook variable). active_hypotheses.success_criteria: HK_Identity in C2 column achieves onb_initiate_checkout CVR-per-link-click ≥ 3% (vs 0% for HK_Benefit in C2B checkout) after 100+ link clicks. active_hypotheses.expected_impact: High if hypothesis is confirmed — it would prove hook type is the primary checkout driver and immediately unlock a systematic hook-rotation programme across all columns.

active_hypotheses.isolated_variable: TN_Urgent (tone variable, additive to TN_Assertive baseline). Distribution: TN_Urgent appears in Row B of C4 column only (1 cell in this sprint) — this is intentionally a single-cell exploratory read given the low evidence base for the ValueStack pillar. active_hypotheses.expected_impact: Low-medium in this sprint; medium-high if directional signal justifies full 2–4 cell distribution in Sprint 2.

active_hypotheses.isolated_variable: ICP_BOOK0_MaleEfficiencyPocket as column constant (avatar-isolation variable). active_hypotheses.label: Testing FW_StoryBrand as the copy framework in the C2 TimePoorLearner column (Row C) will produce higher checkout CVR than FW_BAB (Row A control) by positioning the learner as the hero overcoming information overload, because the current FW_BAB frame presents Bookster as the transformation agent rather than amplifying user agency — a structure that may explain the registration-to-checkout drop-off where users engage with the promise but do not self-identify as the buyer.
active_hypotheses.source: C2B (FW_BAB, 0 checkout conversions on $110.92 spend; 74 registrations at $9.13 CPA)
active_hypotheses.risk: StoryBrand structure requires longer-form copy execution that may underperform on short-attention placements (Reels, Stories). active_hypotheses.isolated_variable: FW_StoryBrand (framework variable). Distribution: FW_StoryBrand appears in Row C of C2 column and Row C of C4 column (aspirational ICP) = 2 cells in different avatar contexts. FW_BAB remains in Row A across both columns = 2 cells. active_hypotheses.success_criteria: FW_StoryBrand achieves onb_initiate_checkout CVR-per-link-click ≥ 4% (double the FW_AIDA benchmark of 4.78% is aspirational; a minimum of 4% in context of zero from FW_BAB would confirm the hypothesis direction) after 100+ link clicks. conversion_tracking_signal.note: Conversion-based tracking: funnel actions are attributed to the converting device/platform/placement. Spend and impressions are not device-attributable under this tracking, so no CPA/CTR exist here. The export window may differ from the account's campaign window — treat cross-surface comparisons as directional.

message_pillars.label: Feed-First Conversion Driver
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: Capitalise on Feed placements' dominant share of adds-to-cart and checkout initiations across all device types. Feed rows account for the overwhelming majority of funnel depth signals in the data (e.g., Feed placement rows show 26, 19, 21, 15, 12, 8 adds-to-cart vs. single digits for Stories/Reels). Anchor the matrix's highest-confidence concept columns in Feed-optimised creative formats that maximise thumbstop and carry the user through intent milestones.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: Feed placements drove the bulk of conversion-adjacent activity: top Feed rows recorded 26, 21, 19, 15, 12 adds-to-cart and checkout initiations of 6, 7, 5, 5 respectively. The sole confirmed purchase in the placement data also occurred on a Feed row (7 link_clicks, 8 adds_to_cart, 1 purchase). Instagram Stories, Reels, and Facebook Reels each show 1–5 adds-to-cart per row and ≤2 checkout initiations. No purchase is attributed to non-Feed placements. C3 has the lowest CPA (€11.04) and highest CVR (21.6%), suggesting its creative/format approach is best converting within Feed.
message_pillars.funnel_application: MOFU–BOFU: creatives assume problem-awareness and move user from consideration to checkout. Feed format allows copy depth, multi-image carousels, or video with clear CTA.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Optimise aspect ratios for Feed (1:1 or 4:5). Lead with a benefit hook in the first 3 seconds/frames. Include explicit price or value anchor. CTA family: 'Shop Now' / 'See Why X People Chose skov'. Advantage+ placements ON — let the algorithm weight Feed where signals are strongest, but do not exclude other placements to preserve learning.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Run under Advantage+ auto-placements (broad, ABO). Feed will self-select as primary delivery based on historical conversion signals. Do not manually pin to Feed-only — allow Stories/Reels to receive impressions and observe if CVR pattern persists.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Once a Feed-optimised cell wins on CTR/thumbstop signal within 3–5 days and ≥500 impressions, flag for budget reallocation to that ABO ad set. C3's CPA (€11.04) is the current benchmark floor; target ≤€11 CPA at scale before duplicating.

message_pillars.label: C3 Concept Expansion — Low-CPA Angle Scaling
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: C3 is the highest-efficiency concept in the account (CPA €11.04, CVR 21.6% link-click-to-result) despite the lowest spend (€88.29) and only 8 results. The priority is to stress-test whether C3's angle holds at higher spend and across varied tone/hook combinations, before declaring it a scaling winner. This pillar dedicates one matrix column to C3-derivative creatives and systematically rotates the angle variables to isolate what is driving efficiency.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: C3: spend €88.29, 8 results, CPA €11.04, CVR 21.6%. C1: spend €140.61, 9 results, CPA €15.62, CVR 2.8%. C2: spend €414.48, 17 results, CPA €24.38, CVR 6.5%. C3 is 55% cheaper per result than C1 and 55% cheaper than C2, on less than a quarter of C2's spend. Confidence in C3 is currently low due to small volume (8 results); this pillar is designed to build that confidence or falsify it.
message_pillars.funnel_application: TOFU–MOFU: replicate the C3 angle at broader reach to test if CVR holds when impressions scale. Use value-stack and before/after framing to attract cold traffic that mirrors whoever responded to C3.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Keep the C3 concept constant (same design system, same CTA family) across all four cells in its matrix column. Vary FW_ and TN_ across rows A–D. Monitor whether ATC rate stays above the account average as spend crosses €150.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Broad targeting, ABO, Advantage+ auto-placements. Do not restrict audience — the goal is to see if the C3 concept self-selects a winning audience segment organically.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: If C3-column cells sustain CPA ≤€13 after 15+ results, escalate budget 20% every 48 hours. If CPA drifts above €18 (C1 benchmark), pause and revert. Low confidence warning: 8 results is insufficient for statistical certainty; treat early scaling as a hypothesis, not a confirmed winner.

message_pillars.label: iPhone Checkout-Gap Bridge
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: iPhone is the dominant link-click device but shows a disproportionate gap between adds-to-cart and purchases. Across iPhone rows, adds-to-cart total 72 and checkouts initiated total 20 against only 1 purchase. This signals a checkout abandonment or friction problem specific to the mobile-Safari / iPhone experience. A dedicated creative pillar targets this gap with BOFU messaging that reduces hesitation and drives the final conversion step.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: iPhone rows: 11+27+18+7+19+10+30+12 = 134 link_clicks; adds_to_cart: 5+8+16+4+3+12+17+7 = 72; checkouts_initiated: 2+2+4+1+2+2+5+2 = 20; purchases: 1 (only from the row with 10 link_clicks, 12 ATC, 2 checkouts). ATC-to-checkout rate on iPhone ≈ 28% (20/72). The single purchase row has ATC:link_click ratio of 1.2 — unusually high, suggesting that when intent is very strong on iPhone, conversion does close. iPad and Android also show similar checkout drop-off patterns but at lower volume.
message_pillars.funnel_application: BOFU: assume the viewer has already considered the product. Address final objections (risk, trust, delivery, returns). Urgency and social proof are the primary levers at this stage.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Creative should surface trust signals prominently: reviews, guarantees, easy returns, delivery promise. Copy framework: PAS — Problem (still haven't ordered?), Agitate (every day without it is X), Solution (here's why 500+ customers clicked buy). CTA: 'Complete Your Order' or 'Get Yours Today'. Keep creative concise — 15s video or single static with bold social-proof overlay. Note: this pillar assumes checkout friction is partly a creative/messaging problem; a parallel UX audit of the mobile checkout flow is recommended.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Advantage+ auto-placements, broad ABO. The algorithm will find recent site visitors and ATC non-converters if the pixel has sufficient data. Do not create manual retargeting audiences — rely on Advantage+ audience expansion to surface high-intent users.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Primary success signal is checkout-to-purchase rate, not CTR. Requires purchase volume to evaluate — do not call a winner until ≥5 purchases per cell variant. Low confidence warning: only 1 purchase is attributed in the entire dataset; purchase-level CPA analysis is not yet viable.

message_pillars.label: Exploratory Avatar Expansion — Instagram-Native Engagement
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: Instagram platform rows show consistently competitive ATC rates relative to link clicks (e.g., 8 link_clicks → 5 ATC; 10 link_clicks → 4 ATC; 10 link_clicks → 15 ATC; 1 confirmed purchase on Instagram). However, no established ICP profile is available. This exploratory pillar tests a psychographic/behavioural avatar hypothesis — a visually-driven, mobile-first discovery shopper — using Instagram-native formats (Reels, Stories) to see if a distinct high-intent segment emerges separate from the Facebook Feed audience.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: Instagram platform rows: purchases = 1 (8 link_clicks, 8 ATC, 1 purchase — 12.5% link-to-purchase rate, the highest in the dataset). Instagram rows also show ATC:link_click ratios of 0.63, 0.40, 1.50 (the 10/15 row), suggesting some Instagram contexts convert to ATC at rates exceeding Facebook. Facebook has higher absolute volume but Instagram shows at least one outlier efficiency point. All claims are low-confidence due to small sample size and absence of spend/impression data at the platform level.
message_pillars.funnel_application: TOFU: cold discovery. Instagram-native UGC or creator-style video to stop the scroll for an audience with no prior brand exposure. The StoryBrand framework creates character identification quickly.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: 9:16 vertical video, 15–30 seconds, UGC aesthetic (no high-production polish). Hook in first 2 seconds must address a recognisable lifestyle moment. No hard sell — end with a soft CTA ('See how it works' / 'Find yours'). Mark this column clearly as EXPLORATORY in the matrix; avatar_basis is hypothesis only, no historical ICP data to validate.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Advantage+ auto-placements. The algorithm will route vertical video to Reels and Stories. Broad targeting — do not add interest or demographic constraints. Watch thumbstop rate and 3-second view rate as primary early signals before any purchase signal is available.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: This is an exploratory column. Do not scale based on ATC alone. Require ≥3 purchases or a CTR significantly above account average before increasing budget. Treat results as directional input for the next MST cycle's ICP definition.

active_hypotheses.label: Replacing a rational benefit-led hook (HK_Benefit) with a social-proof hook (HK_SocialProof) in Feed-optimised creatives will increase adds-to-cart rate, because the dataset's highest ATC:click rows correlate with contexts where trust/validation signals are prominent.
active_hypotheses.source: Pillar 1 — Feed-First Conversion Driver (CN_ProductDemo + HK_Benefit baseline)

message_pillars.label: Feed-First Product Desire Loop
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: Feed placements dominate both click and cart volume across devices. This pillar locks Feed as the primary creative canvas and tests concept angles that maximize thumb-stop and add-to-cart rate — the two most readable early signals available in this account.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: Feed placements account for the majority of adds-to-cart in the dataset; the single highest-volume Feed row shows 22 link_clicks → 49 adds_to_cart (ATC rate >200% of clicks, indicating browse/scroll re-exposure), and a separate Feed row delivers 34 link_clicks → 14 ATC. Confirmed purchases on Feed: at least 1 attributed. Instagram Stories shows a strong outlier (2 link_clicks → 16 ATC → 5 checkouts → 1 purchase), suggesting high-intent micro-placement worth isolating. Facebook Reels and Threads each show 1 row with minimal volume — insufficient to action. Evidence is low-volume; treat as directional.
message_pillars.funnel_application: TOFU awareness and ATC generation. Feed creative must earn the scroll-stop AND the cart tap in a single exposure. Stories variant acts as a MOFU retargeting complement.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Square/vertical 4:5 ratio optimised for Feed. Hero visual leads with the pet product in use (lifestyle moment). FAB copy structure: Feature → Advantage → Benefit in three text beats. CTA family: 'Shop Now' / 'See It In Action'. Distinct from Stories variant (9:16, shorter copy). Do NOT produce near-duplicate sizing — treat Feed and Stories as separate concept columns in the matrix.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Advantage+ auto-placements ON under Andromeda ABO structure. The Feed-dominant signal supports letting the algorithm allocate, but creative must be natively built for Feed first. Stories-specific creative isolated in its own matrix column so placement signal can be read separately.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Monitor ATC rate (adds_to_cart / link_clicks) as primary thumbstop proxy given purchase volume is too low for CPA verdict at this stage. Scale budget on cells where ATC rate exceeds account average once 50+ ATC events are logged per cell.

message_pillars.label: iPhone-Native UGC Social Proof Engine
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: iPhone is the dominant device across every funnel stage in the dataset. UGC-style creative natively matches iPhone consumption patterns and pairs with social proof messaging to reduce purchase friction — critical given the high checkout drop-off observed (many rows show 5–17 checkouts initiated with 0 confirmed purchases).
message_pillars.why_it_matters: iPhone rows account for 11 of 20 device-level rows. One iPhone row shows 17 link_clicks → 50 ATC → 17 checkouts → 1 purchase; another shows 11 link_clicks → 55 ATC → 11 checkouts → 1 purchase; another shows 18 link_clicks → 8 ATC → 8 checkouts → 1 purchase. Checkout-to-purchase conversion is extremely low across all rows (typically 1 purchase per 3–17 checkouts initiated), pointing to a confidence or trust gap at the final step. Android shows weaker ATC ratios. iPad rows are small-sample but show 2 of 3 confirmed purchases — noted but insufficient to action. All purchase counts are low; confidence is limited.
message_pillars.funnel_application: MOFU trust-building targeting warm audiences and broad cold audiences simultaneously (Andromeda broad). The goal is to close the checkout → purchase gap by injecting peer proof before the final tap.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Raw-feel vertical video (9:16 and 4:5 cuts) shot on or styled as iPhone footage. Real or real-styled pet owner testimonial as hook. StoryBrand structure: character (pet owner) → problem (product search pain) → guide (SKOV Pet) → success (happy pet). On-screen text captions mandatory for silent autoplay. CTA family: 'Read Reviews' / 'See Why Pet Owners Love It' / 'Shop with Confidence'.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Advantage+ auto-placements. UGC format performs natively across Feed and Stories without manual placement forcing. Let algorithm route; measure ATC and checkout rate by placement post-hoc.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Track checkout initiation rate (checkouts / ATC) as the key mid-funnel metric. If UGC cells lift checkout rate vs. non-UGC cells by >20% at 30+ checkout events, prioritise budget shift. Do not declare winner on purchase count alone given current low volume.

message_pillars.label: Instagram-First Visual Desire Hook
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: Instagram (Feed + Stories combined) carries the highest concentration of ATC events and all but one confirmed purchase in the platform-level data. This pillar tests visually-led, emotion-first angles optimised for Instagram's algorithmic content environment under broad Advantage+ targeting.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: Instagram platform rows: one row shows 17 link_clicks → 42 ATC → 15 checkouts → 1 purchase; another shows 7 link_clicks → 51 ATC → 10 checkouts → 1 purchase; Instagram Stories row shows 2 link_clicks → 16 ATC → 5 checkouts → 1 purchase. Facebook Feed rows by comparison show higher link_clicks but lower ATC ratios (e.g. 17 clicks → 8 ATC, 15 clicks → 11 ATC, 13 clicks → 5 ATC). Instagram appears to generate disproportionate ATC per click. All numbers are low-volume; treat as directional signal only.
message_pillars.funnel_application: TOFU cold audience entry via Instagram Feed and Stories. PAS framework surfaces the pet owner pain (problem hook) → agitates the emotional cost → pivots to SKOV Pet as the relief. Lifestyle visual does the stopping; copy closes the emotional loop.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: High-quality lifestyle imagery or short-form video (under 15s) showing pet + owner in aspirational but relatable home moment. Problem statement in first 2 seconds of video or as headline overlay on static. Aspect ratios: 4:5 for Feed, 9:16 for Stories — built separately, not cropped. CTA family: 'Discover the Difference' / 'Shop Now'. No heavy product spec copy — emotion drives the tap.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Advantage+ auto-placements with creative natively built for Instagram proportions. Facebook will receive creative via auto-placement but Instagram-native assets should be uploaded directly. Monitor platform-level ATC split post-launch.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: Use Instagram ATC rate as the primary 72-hour signal. If Instagram cells sustain ATC/click ratio >2:1 (as seen in top rows), prioritise spend. Pause Facebook-only cells that show <0.5 ATC/click ratio after 500 impressions per cell.

message_pillars.label: Checkout Friction Eliminator — BOFU Confidence Close
message_pillars.plain_descriptor: Exploratory expansion pillar. The account-wide data shows a systemic checkout abandonment pattern: across nearly every device and platform row, checkouts initiated dramatically outnumber purchases. This BOFU pillar is a transparent exploratory hypothesis — no historical creative data exists for it — designed to test direct confidence-removal messaging (guarantee, returns, trust signals) aimed at the abandonment moment.
message_pillars.why_it_matters: Across 20 device rows: total checkouts initiated sum to approximately 78, total confirmed purchases sum to 5 — an implied checkout-to-purchase rate of ~6.4%. Across 20 platform rows: similar pattern. This is not a traffic problem; it is a conversion confidence problem. No existing creative data exists for BOFU-specific angles in this account. This column is EXPLORATORY (avatar_basis: exploratory, target_icp: blank). Numbers are attribution-window estimates; treat with caution.
message_pillars.funnel_application: BOFU warm retargeting of checkout-initiated non-purchasers and ATC non-converters. BAB structure: Before (stuck at checkout, unsure) → After (confident, pet thriving) → Bridge (SKOV Pet guarantee/proof removes the risk). Value stack communicates offer completeness: product + guarantee + support + fast shipping in one frame.
message_pillars.execution_specifications: Static or short video (6–10s). Lead with risk-reversal headline: e.g. 'Not sure yet? Here's why 1,000+ pet owners chose SKOV' (copy must be grounded in real social proof before launch — do not fabricate numbers in live creative). Trust badges, return policy, and star rating visible. CTA family: 'Complete Your Order' / 'Get It Risk-Free'. This is an exploratory column — all four cells should vary angle variables broadly to discover what resonates before optimising.
message_pillars.placement_strategy: Advantage+ auto-placements. For retargeting signal, use ABO with a separate warm-audience ad set if platform allows. Under pure Andromeda broad structure, this column acts as a BOFU signal test within the broad pool — watch checkout-to-purchase rate as the key metric.
message_pillars.scaling_guidance: This is exploratory. Do not scale before seeing at least 10 purchases attributed across the column's cells. Primary early signal: checkout-to-purchase rate improvement vs. account baseline (~6.4%). If any cell reaches >15% checkout-to-purchase rate at 20+ checkout events, escalate to dedicated BOFU sprint.

The main diagonal (C1A, C2B, C3C, C4D) and counter diagonal (C1D, C2C, C3B, C4A) will carry cross-avatar tonality signals for highest-confidence reading.
